title: What Is Metacognition? — Exploring the Metacognition Cycle
skills: define metacognition and explain its role in learning
identify stages of the metacognition cycle
plan, monitor, and evaluate personal learning strategies
apply reflective thinking to reading, writing, revision, and academic problem solving
alignment_note: Introduces metacognition and the cycle of planning, monitoring, and evaluating one's own learning. Supports reflective writing, self-assessment, revision, reading comprehension, study strategies, and independent learning across high school English courses.
